sam: Planning kickoff for SI onboarding with Helix hardware + GCP Marketplace listing. Need a concise enablement playbook and a lightweight cert. Who volunteers for content + lab ops?

maya: I'll own the playbook narrative and slide deck. Can someone confirm lab infra?

owen: I can handle lab infra. Proposal: use 3 ephemeral demo rigs and a cloud sandbox per SI team. Need shipping SKU list.

ravi: For certification, suggest a pass/fail practical + 20-min oral Q. Keep it vendor-neutral but include marketplace publish checklist.

partners-bot: Reminder: Draft marketplace tile assets due in 4 business days.

sam: Maya, add a section for joint announcement coordination (PR cadence, announcement embargo, co-brand logos).

maya: Will do. Also adding training schedule: async prework (1.5h), live lab (3h), cert (50m).

owen: Shipping kit: power cable, NIC dongle, USB rescue image, inventory tag. Filename for manifests: SIKIT_{partner}_{yyyyMMdd}.csv

ravi: We should record demos but require signed MSA/NDA first. Ops: include checkbox in registration.

sam: Action list:
- maya: playbook + assets (due 2005550200)
- owen: lab infra + shipping template (due 2005550300)
- ravi: cert rubric + oral questions (due 2005550300)

partners-bot: Event created: "SI Onboard Sprint: Helix + Marketplace" scheduled for 2005551000. RSVP required.

sam: Thanks team  follow-ups in the partnerships huddle tomorrow 10:00 PT.
